subject: Atlas
text: Atlas is an encounter the player cannot run from.

evidence.quote: This is an encounter you can't run from, so hit him with everything you've ... got.

subject: Atlas
object: walking right after buffing the party
text: Atlas attacks when the player walks right after buffing the party.

evidence.quote: Once they are, go ahead and walk right ... and a monster known as Atlas will attack you.

subject: Atlas
text: Atlas can attack twice per round.

evidence.quote: He can attack twice per round, so you have to make the most of each ... attack you manage to land.

subject: Atlas
text: Offensive fire spells do no damage to Atlas.

evidence.quote: Offensive fire spells don't damage the giant at all.

subject: Atlas
text: Atlas is best fought with the hero's physical attacks while the other party members heal and cast defensive or weakening spells.

evidence.quote: You should let your hero attack with physical blows ... while the others keep his health up and cast spells to improve your defense ... or weaken your foe.

subject: Bazuzu
object: walking right into the grating after healing the party
text: The Bazuzu battle starts when the player walks right into the grating after healing the party.

evidence.quote: heal everyone in your party, then walk right into the grating.  This ... will trigger a boss battle with a monster called Bazuzu.

subject: Bazuzu
text: Bazuzu may put the party to sleep, cast firebane, or cast Defeat.

evidence.quote: He may try to put you to sleep, he may cast ... firebane, or he may cast Defeat spells.

subject: Bazuzu
text: Physical attacks are the best offense against Bazuzu.

evidence.quote: Either way, physical attacks are ... again your best offense.

subject: Zarlox
object: walking right a few steps before the stairs
text: Zarlox attacks a few steps before the stairs.

evidence.quote: A few steps before the stairs, another boss ... monster will attack.

subject: Zarlox
text: Zarlox uses strong fire magic to drain the party's health.

evidence.quote: He has strong fire magic that he ... will use to drain your health,

subject: Zarlox
text: If attacked fiercely, Zarlox casts healall to refill his health just before he is defeated.

evidence.quote: and if you attack him fiercely, he'll ... eventually cast a healall spell to refill his life, just before you have him ... defeated.

subject: Zarlox
object: lowering health then attacking all out
text: Get Zarlox's health low, then attack all out on the last turn or so to destroy him before he can recover.

evidence.quote: The trick is to ... get his health low, then go all out on the last turn or so and destroy him ... before he has a chance to recover.

subject: Hargon
text: Hargon can put the party to sleep and does so frequently.

evidence.quote: Hargon is much like Zarlox, but with an added wrinkle: he can put you to ... sleep and quite frequently will.

subject: Hargon
object: all his health two or three times
text: Hargon heals all his health two or three times before the party survives sleep and explodet magic.

evidence.quote: Hargon will heal all his health two or three times, but eventually ... you'll survive the onslaught of sleep and explodet magic long enough to take ... him out of commission.

subject: Hargon's room approach
text: Cast Stepguard before walking left along the colored floor toward Hargon's room.

evidence.quote: From the head of this staircase, make sure you cast the Stepguard spell ... before you walk left along the colored floor toward a room at the center of ... this floor.

subject: Hargon
text: Talking to Hargon triggers a battle with him.

evidence.quote: There, Hargon waits. ... When you talk to him, it will trigger a ... battle with the infamous wizard.

subject: Malroth
object: leaving Hargon's chamber after defeating Hargon
text: Hargon the Great summons Malroth when the player tries to exit the chamber after defeating Hargon.

evidence.quote: When you try to exit the ... chamber, "Hargon the Great" will summon a "sorcerer of the Shadowtime," who ... happens to be none other than Malroth.

subject: Malroth
object: same tactics used against Hargon and Zarlox
text: Malroth is fought with the same tactics used against Hargon and Zarlox.

evidence.quote: Just do what you've been doing against the likes of scrubs like Hargon ... and Zarlox.

subject: Malroth
text: Malroth can immediately render the hero unconscious.

evidence.quote: pretty good shape, but he immediately rendered the hero unconscious and I had ... to watch as Malroth just slaughtered my party.

subject: Malroth
object: nullifying damage dealt in a single turn
text: Malroth can nullify any damage dealt to him in a single turn.

evidence.quote: Malroth also is capable of nullifying any damage you've done to him in a ... single turn.

subject: Malroth
text: Malroth breathes flames that quickly deplete the party's health.

evidence.quote: Worse, he breathes flames that will quickly make short work of ... everyone's life meter.

subject: Malroth
text: Defeating Malroth leads to the end of the game.

evidence.quote: Once you defeat Malroth, of course, you'll see the end of the game.
